what_human_must_do: The page did not load. Try the URL yourself; record 403/404 in fetch-report.
where_to_resume: python tools/triage.py https://www.nexira.ai/airdrops   # then re-run bulk_apply
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the airdrop page and register Go to the Nexira airdrop page and register for the campaigns. The page lists Airdrop Season 1, Airdrop Season 2, the New Year's Campaign and Ruby Unlock Week.

2 Step 2 : Complete missions to claim Reward Boxes Finish the missions, tasks and mini-events shown for a campaign to earn Reward Boxes. The project says it checks task completion with on-chain and social data.
3 Step 3 : Open your boxes to receive Locked Ruby Opening a Reward Box gives you Locked Ruby. It unlocks into Ruby once you complete the required missions and the Pre-TGE unlock window arrives.
4 Step 4 : Convert Ruby to NEXI Ruby is what converts to NEXI at TGE. Check the airdrop page for the current state of claiming, since its printed February 2026 dates have passed.
5 Step 5 : Read the allocation details The tokenomics page shows how the airdrop allocation sits next to the other token allocations and their vesting.
